headline: Paused for your review. Andhra Pradesh: 95% of deep aspects have exact records in agriculture and finance; Tamil Nadu: 100% in both. MVP plan when you say: deepen data, review it by hand, web search for gaps, then answer structure.
decisions: Your rules (6 Nov) stay in force: you are head of the project and I act as senior project manager; this page is updated only when you ask, with Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu completion in percent; data and engine are equal focuses; testing comes later.

MVP plan (your words, 7 Nov), in order, for Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, agriculture and finance: 1) deepen the data, including sub-aspects; 2) review the data by hand: which types of data are present and which are missing; 3) web search for what isn't there, using it if an official source checks out (and adding it to the store) or saying clearly that none was found; 4) change the structure and quality of the answers. Other states belong to the full product. All four are planned, not started. Details are on the Current plan tab.
Models (7 Nov, for now): Groq is primary and Gemini the fallback until you choose a paid API. The key is only in .env.

You are reviewing this page for the next few days. Nothing runs until you say to resume. The full technical account of how VETRA finds documents and checks answers is at the top of the Current plan tab.
next: Andhra Pradesh, deep level: agriculture 42 of 44 aspects have exact records (95%), 27 of 44 have three or more (61%); finance 20 of 21 (95%), 10 of 21 with three or more (48%). The aspects still without a record were searched and no official source exists: paddy bonus over MSP and a farmers' welfare board (agriculture), and a women's stamp duty concession (finance). Held: 217 documents, about 6,860 passages, 378 exact records.

Tamil Nadu, deep level: agriculture 44 of 44 aspects with exact records (100%), 36 of 44 with three or more (82%); finance 21 of 21 (100%), 13 of 21 with three or more (62%). Held: 190 documents, about 9,720 passages, 346 exact records.

Central rules that apply in every state: 72 records from 24 documents, including PM-KISAN, Kisan Credit Card interest and the new RBI KCC rules (from 1 Jan 2027), fertiliser prices, eNAM, land acquisition compensation, PMFME, drones, farm machinery subsidy (SMAM, Dec 2025), Soil Health Card and the Natural Farming Mission.

New on 7 Nov: Andhra Pradesh: freehold rights on assigned land (G.O.Ms.No.588), Amaravati land pooling, National Family Benefit Scheme, PMAY-Urban 2.0, mango price support, cooperative credit, finance commission grants, budget and debt, paraquat ban, fertiliser at RSKs, seed appeals. Tamil Nadu: women's 1% registration fee cut, construction and other workers' welfare boards, fishermen and traders boards, TAHDCO land purchase for SC/ST women, Annal Ambedkar scheme, soil fertility mission, sericulture, free farm power, tax arrears settlement, local cess.

Engine and code (243 tests pass): record lookups now search both topics, so a cooperative loan filed under agriculture answers a finance question; search drops repeated passages (two TN documents were held twice); the grounding check reads percentages and financial years and looks in central documents; a register (knowledge/searched.jsonl) records what was searched and not found, shown separately here; the build queue takes a lock so two builds never start together.
issues: Nothing is tested. Every count means held, not right. All 270 records whose source is held match their documents figure by figure; some were read from scans and are flagged. A person should review them before launch.

Andhra Pradesh aspects with fewer than three records: agriculture: loan waiver, KCC, wildlife damage, seed, soil health, natural farming, drip, farm ponds, wells, solar pumps, dairy, food processing, tenancy, land conversion, land acquisition; finance: debt, finance commission, guideline values, state GST, land revenue, electricity duty, property tax, tax arrears, state loans, housing. Most need official AP orders that the GO index and reachable department sites don't have.

Tamil Nadu aspects with fewer than three records: agriculture: loan waiver, drip, sericulture, eNAM, food processing, land conversion, land acquisition, extension offices; finance: debt, finance commission, guideline values, land revenue, electricity duty, property tax, tax arrears, women concessions.

Percent caveat: completion counts keyword matches against each aspect, so the figures are a guide, not a grade; an aspect with one record counts as covered, which is why the three-or-more figure is shown beside it.
workers: Head of the project: decide, set priorities, ask for page updates
Plans, reads documents and enters exact records, designs and changes the engine and code, reports here when asked
Crawling, picking documents, downloads, OCR, order links, rate lines, search builds
Run only when started for a task
Reads scanned orders on the PC

log.text: Monitoring station set up on this page, with the architecture, diagrams and techniques updated. Today: first hand-marked test, 157 of 179 good, marked by me before the fixes. Added 36 exact rates across Andhra Pradesh deeds, vehicle tax and relief, Tamil Nadu vehicle tax and Chennai profession tax, all unreviewed. Engine: 3 checks added, 231 code tests pass. Listed 18,441 Andhra Pradesh orders and about 3,300 official PDFs. Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu aren't done.

You removed the fixed date, so work goes in logical order: collect, ask, read, fix, then the next state. Checked this page against the code and corrected it: tests are 231, exact records and scan reading are shown, and stale document lists are gone. The older Version 1 tabs are kept as history and weren't checked.
The aspect run stalled for about an hour because the free model limits ran out. It now uses gemini-3.1-flash-lite and stops itself after 3 misses in a row.

The test run is paused at 56 of 136 because it was too slow on free limits. 8 Andhra Pradesh records added from official orders: pensions, fishing ban relief and poultry. Next: more rates from documents already held, then the open data gaps.

8 more records from documents already held: Tamil Nadu pensions, fishing relief and electricity tax range; Andhra Pradesh rooftop solar for BC consumers and the closed property tax waiver. Test run stays paused. None of these has been through a full answer yet.

On your rule, no free models and no testing. 50 exact records entered tonight, including Tamil Nadu's official paddy incentive and crop loan waiver. PC is downloading picked orders with no model. New: each order's number and what it replaces is read automatically and carried through to the answer.

Morning report, 06:58. Since the 22:22 report: 49 exact records entered (42 agriculture, 6 finance, 1 date), 1 repeat removed. None has been through a full answer; all are marked unreviewed. Documents: 115 scanned Tamil Nadu agriculture orders fetched and read by OCR (27 routine ones dropped, 28 named from their abstracts), 1 Andhra Pradesh DEEPAM-2 order added. Builds: finance AP (+7 chunks), agriculture AP (no change), finance TN (no change), agriculture TN (+2,890 chunks from the scans). What failed: Tesseract crashed on one page at 01:40 and stopped the Tamil Nadu agriculture build; fixed so a bad page is skipped, test added, rebuilt by 02:56. My own failure: the hourly checks from 02:00 to 06:00 did not run, so the PC sat idle for about four hours after 02:57. Andhra Pradesh, added: horticulture subsidies (polyhouse, shade net, mulching, farm pond, nets, orchards, mushroom, pack house, machinery), paddy procurement KMS 2026-27, electricity duty range (from a Bill), free LPG cylinders and piped gas subsidy, pension eligibility, Annadatha, livestock insurance, Kharif 2026 drought, mango insurance date. Andhra Pradesh, still missing: electricity duty rate per category, guideline values, wildlife damage compensation, used-vehicle tax, women's stamp concession, ration entitlement, field-crop machinery subsidy. Tamil Nadu, added: state pension eligibility, Uzhavar Pathukappu, ration entitlement, unemployment aid, machinery hire 2026-27, solar fencing, threshing floors, drones for women, soil conservation, skimming wells, custom hiring centres, SC/ST borewells, ponds, dairy, native breeds, solar dryers. Tamil Nadu, still missing: women's 1% registration fee cut (press only), wildlife crop damage rates (G.O.(D) No.141 of 2016 not found online), Rabi 2026-27 insurance dates, notified electricity tax rate, KMS 2026-27 paddy incentive. Usage: 5-hour 5%, weekly 19% (last report's 20 and 14 were wrong; real then was 24 and 15). You asked me to keep going until 3 pm; I am.

Update on your request. New rules in force: you are head, I am senior project manager; page updated only when you ask, with completion percentages; no usage or pacing rules; data and engine are equal focuses; testing later. Completion at deep level (exact records): Andhra Pradesh agriculture 68%, finance 62%; Tamil Nadu agriculture 86%, finance 62%. Text held: AP 98% and 95%, TN 100% and 100%. Nothing tested. Background jobs stopped; waiting for your instruction.

Update on your request (7 Nov). Completion at deep level: Andhra Pradesh agriculture 95% of aspects with exact records (61% with three or more), finance 95% (48%); Tamil Nadu agriculture 100% (82%), finance 100% (62%). Aspects with no record in Andhra Pradesh were searched and have no official source; they are listed in a register. Groq is now primary and Gemini the fallback, as you asked; the key is in .env only. 243 tests pass; nothing tested on answers. Waiting for your instruction.

Goal update on your request (7 Nov). The MVP plan now has three remaining steps for Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, agriculture and finance: refine answers; a live web-search fallback that uses official sites only, adds what checks out to the store and says clearly when nothing official is found; and sub-aspects to broaden and deepen each aspect. Other states are for the full product. The Current plan tab now opens with this plan and a step-by-step account of how VETRA plans, searches, checks and cites. Completion unchanged: Andhra Pradesh 95% and 95%, Tamil Nadu 100% and 100% of deep aspects with exact records. Paused for your review.
